# Deepset Powers Production-Ready Generative AI on AWS with Open Source and Speed

## Deepset and AWS

Deepset uses AWS to support fast, production-ready deployments of generative AI. Its open-source Haystack framework and Deepset AI platform run fully on AWS, using services like Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker to power secure, scalable AI infrastructure.

> ""We've been partnering with AWS for quite some time because AWS is just the standard. With AWS, our customers are able to scale, grow their products and services, and we can bring our generative AI solutions into production within days."

Anna Gründler

Senior Director Strategy & Business Development, Deepset
